purpose: Curated, source-linked Strudel technique cards. Retrieval should offer relevant mechanisms, not dictate song structure. Documentation support is separate from MotifAI runtime and playback verification.

runtime_contract.promotion_rule: Do not promote a technique past documentation-supported until the corresponding runtime or playback observation has actually occurred.

research_sources.role: Official reference for mini-notation grouping, parallel events, weighted durations, rests, alternation, and Euclidean rhythms.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use documented grammar and short idiom examples as technical guidance.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not infer that every example's sound assets exist in MotifAI beyond the documented default map.
research_sources.license_status: Official documentation reference; individual example snippets remain attributed to the documentation.

research_sources.role: Official reference for pattern construction and composition of pattern values.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use function patterns and their documented semantics as technical guidance.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not invent APIs or assume all packages are loaded in the embedded REPL.

research_sources.role: Official reference for fast, slow, Euclidean, early, and late timing modifiers.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use timing modifiers as documented, with musical intent.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not confuse cycle time with seconds or bars.

research_sources.role: Official reference for sample maps, default drum abbreviations, banks, sample variants, and lazy loading.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use default-map names and bank semantics with accurate dependency notes.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not promise a particular optional bank, sample variant, or external asset without runtime verification.

research_sources.role: Official reference for effects, signal flow, filters, delays, reverb, and orbit routing.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use effect names, documented parameter domains, and signal-flow behavior.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not claim different settings stack serially in the same effect slot; do not treat orbit as an independent effect plugin.

research_sources.role: Official reference for built-in synthesis sources and synth parameters.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use documented synthesizer sources and envelopes as technique guidance.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not assume custom or third-party synth names are registered.

research_sources.role: Official reference for pattern transformations such as reverse and stereo juxtaposition.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use documented pattern transforms and their semantics.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not assume a transform preserves musical intent in every composition; audition results.

research_sources.role: Official reference for practical, composable Strudel technique recipes.
research_sources.allowed_use: Adapt individual mechanisms to original material.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not copy complete community compositions, distinctive melodies, or arrangements.

research_sources.role: Official reference for signal patterns and continuous parameter control.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use signals and ranges with parameter-domain awareness.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not assume a pattern signal is continuously sampled between note triggers.

research_sources.role: Official reference for low-frequency oscillator control.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use documented LFO controls only where needed and supported.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not invent argument keys or modulation semantics.

research_sources.role: Official reference for tonal functions, scales, and pitch relationships.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use documented scale and pitch operations as compositional tools.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not force tonality when the musical brief does not call for it.

research_sources.role: Official reference for chord voicings and chord-related patterns.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use voicing examples to guide register and chord construction.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not claim a fixed voicing is universally appropriate.

research_sources.role: Official reference for controlled random pattern variation.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use randomness intentionally for ornament, texture, and variation.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not make essential anchors randomly disappear unless desired.

research_sources.role: Official reference for the cycle clock and timing model.
research_sources.allowed_use: Use CPS and cycle semantics when estimating timing.
research_sources.excluded_use: Do not equate cycles with bars or seconds without stated assumptions.
